info.name: MagicMatch by LiquiDonate Donate Match API
Estimate a nonprofit match and shipping rate

items.docs: Returns a nonprofit match and an estimated shipping rate without creating a shipment. Always pass the returned match UUID into v1/matchAndShip so the same nonprofit match and rate are used.

info.name: Match items to a nonprofit and buy the donation label

items.docs: Matches the supplied items to a nearby nonprofit and purchases a shipping label in one call. Use for standard parcel-shippable items only - furniture, mattresses, drug paraphernalia, items over 50 kg and items returned as Damaged are excluded; route those to v1/donate. Pass `match_uuid` from v1/matchAndShip/estimate to lock in the previewed match and rate.

Returns a nonprofit match for the supplied items. Does not estimate shipping and does not create a shipment. If you buy your own label you must follow up with v1/match/ship so the nonprofit is notified of the incoming parcel and donation receipts can be generated. Same category, weight and damaged-return exclusions as v1/matchAndShip.
